life Complete app · v17
v17 · New orb states: band, globe, constellation, listening

Every feature. One calm app that grows with you.

This is the whole of life, with every piece of your feedback in: solid surfaces (no glass), the dot-field Pulse driving a diverse cast of photos, the Chief Aim, a full Body chapter (devices, readiness, sleep, load, photo food logging, habits) and Teach it back. In total, 34 screens in 21 chapters, organised the way you move through the app (tab → area → screen, with how each one opens), from first open to level four. Every function already in the engine has a home here, the numbers come from the engine itself, and it all speaks one language.

Sitemap

How the app fits together.

Three tabs (Today, Plan, You) and the Talk button in the middle. Each column is one place in the app, in the order you’d meet it; the tag says how each screen opens (tab, push, sheet, full screen). Tap any screen to jump to it.

Component library

Every component, and where it's used.

These are all real code now, in apps/mobile/src/design, live in the app's /design gallery, and they build for iOS and Android. Tap a screen to jump to it. Screens are assembled from these; nothing gets rebuilt.
